paragraphs: Manoach. (Manoach, father of Samson, [Judges chapter 13, verse 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Judges.13.2)).
Rav Huna bar Manoach, [Taanit 15a (compare 9a in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.9a.14).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Taanit passage at 9a names Rav Huna bar Manoach, as does [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=989&lang=en). Hyman supplies 15a. The biblical Manoach and the rabbinic patronymic are separate notices.
